lessons.trigger_condition: V388 maintains regime-conditioned verified policy portfolios, uncertainty/resource budgets and a prioritized feature backlog, but it does not explicitly learn a verified meta-critic for contribution quality, choose the highest-priority operational improvement goal, or steer the next cycle with a goal-aligned canonical capability.
lessons.prevention_rule: V390 must preserve V388 as the mandatory upstream gate, train its device-local meta-critic only when verified sample counts increase, derive goals only from operational KPI gaps, drift, uncertainty, resource pressure, portfolio state and non-executable feature backlog evidence, persist at most one canonical V373 capability for the next cycle only behind the V388 hard gate, and keep source-level functionality as non-executable protected PR/CI plans with shadow/canary/regression/integrity/alignment/actual-output validation.
validation_required: watched paths are main, tablet_autonomous_evolution_v390.py and tablet_runtime_manifest.py
main evolve route uses tablet_autonomous_evolution_v390.py with tablet_gpt domain
tablet runtime manifest includes v390 while preserving v388 and prior controllers
meta critic trains only from new verified V388 portfolio sample-count increases
replaying unchanged verified aggregate rows does not increment critic sample count or retrain weights
goal selection uses operational KPI deficits, drift, uncertainty, resource headroom, portfolio state and feature backlog only
goal-alignment execution hold requires a mature critic and cannot override recovery or V388 hard gates
goal-directed runtime self-extension uses only canonical V373 declarative capability validation
V390 capability writes are forbidden when the V388 preview hard gate is blocked
source-level feature needs remain non-executable and require shadow, targeted, related regression, canary, full runtime, repository integrity, Tablet GPT alignment and actual-output validation
market direction, facts, prices and grades are never invented
peer model weights and raw state are never imported
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V390 autonomously selects bounded improvement goals and next-cycle declarative steering only. It does not generate or rewrite runtime source code, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main, bypass V388 or earlier verification, promote unverified facts/prices/grades, infer market direction, import peer weights/raw state, or claim physical-device success without evidence.
